execution_ref_policy: Resolve the immutable execution commit from GITHUB_SHA and record it in the artifact.

one_changed_factor.name: entropy_cost
one_changed_factor.rationale: The pinned official SILG launch.py defines both 0.05 and 0.005 for RTFM. The failed immutable run evaluated only 0.05. This run tests the remaining official value without changing architecture, data, seeds, split, frame request, actor count, batch size, unroll length, or matched evaluation instances.

required_artifacts: three checkpoints with actual frame count, bytes and SHA-256
per-seed peak RSS and training wall time
raw install, training, evaluation and qualification logs
qualification: correct win rate greater than random
failure_policy: If this official entropy value also fails, retain initial_reproduction_failure, reject entropy_cost as the sole cause, and proceed to exactly one next diagnosed factor. Do not create a new mechanism family, toy hypothesis, branch, or PR chain.
